title: Save Physical stacking configuration
params.physicalProps: Physical properties. If not passed in, the current PCB properties are used by default
params.allowOverwrite: Whether to allow overwriting a physical stacking configuration with the same name. If `false`, `false` will be returned when a configuration with the same name is encountered. Please note the possible risk of data loss
